## Example

```html
<sherpa-key-value-list data-orientation="vertical"></sherpa-key-value-list>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-key-value-list`:

```json
[
  {
    "key": "Plan",
    "value": "Pro"
  },
  {
    "key": "Seats",
    "value": "12"
  }
]
```
